patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Lightspeed Retail and Wix share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Lightspeed Retail only if your buying job matches “Retail POS + omnichannel — Basic $89/mo, Core $149 highlighted, Plus $289/mo USD; Lightspe” rather than Wix's shape. Choose Wix only if your buying job matches “Website-first builder with ecommerce from Core — Light $17/mo annual, Core $29 (sell onlin” rather than Lightspeed Retail's shape. Workflow advantage: Lightspeed Retail leans omnichannel-retail; Wix leans checkout-conversion, catalog-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Lightspeed Retail and Wix share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Lightspeed Retail is Retail POS + omnichannel — Basic $89/mo, Core $149 highlighted, Plus $289/mo USD; Lightspeed Payments ~1.5% card-present; eCommerce on highe; Wix is Website-first builder with ecommerce from Core — Light $17/mo annual, Core $29 (sell online), Business $39, Business Elite $159 (annual tile.
- Company-size focus: Lightspeed Retail (small-business, mid-market) vs Wix (solo, micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: Lightspeed Retail-leaning omnichannel-retail vs Wix-leaning checkout-conversion, catalog-management, website-builder-commerce.
- Researched limits: Lightspeed Retail — No free plan or documented self-serve trial — contact sales is the common path; Wix — Website-builder commerce depth trails Shopify-class platforms on complex catalogs and B2B.

Limitations — Lightspeed Retail: No free plan or documented self-serve trial — contact sales is the common path; Third-party payment processors may incur a high monthly surcharge versus Lightspeed Payments (~1.5% card-present) — confirm live; Wix: Website-builder commerce depth trails Shopify-class platforms on complex catalogs and B2B; Plan gates for selling start at Core — Free/Light are not store plans.

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
